steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); s.setQualityTier?.('medium'); })()

steps.name: sweep-config
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setClipTimeSweep(true); s.setClipSweepStartHour(8); s.setClipSweepEndHour(22); s.beginTimeSweep(); })()

steps.name: open-view-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'View ▾'); if (!b) throw new Error('View menu trigger not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: probe-toggle
steps.eval: (() => { const has = document.body.textContent.includes('Day → night sweep'); return 'desktop toggle present: ' + has; })()
